text:
The tight constraints force three blocks. Gus comes immediately after Hana, and Hana is before Finn with exactly one slot between them, so the middle slot is Gus: the block is Hana–Gus–Finn. Ben comes immediately after Cara, and that pair must sit entirely before Hana, with Ben at least three slots from Gus, so Ben is at least two slots before Hana. Ivo is before Gus and at least three slots from Hana, so Ivo is at least three slots before Hana.

Trying every legal start for Hana–Gus–Finn leaves a single placement that also fits Ann, Dev, Cara, and Ben:

- Ann is before Ben, at least three slots away, and exactly one slot from Dev.
- Dev is before both Ben and Hana.
- Ben is at least three slots from Ivo.

Those conditions pin every named person. The only open slot is 6, which is Eve (the remaining person in this set).

CONFIDENCE: 86
